'''Corellian Science Academy''' was an [[academy]] operating on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Tan Kirin]] was a professor at the academy.<ref name="SWTOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Corellian Science Academy is mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in the letter [[Elara Dorne]] sends to Trooper if the player pursued the romance option.

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1stm}}
